title: Native or local reviewer sign-off
description: Sign-off record for an L3 to L5 market adaptation, at projects/<campaign>/markets/<market-id>/decisions/native_review.json, or for one matrix variant at projects/<campaign>/markets/<market-id>/<variant-key>/decisions/native_review.json. It is written only from the reviewer's or the user's own words and binds the reviewed files and card fields by hash; a change to any of them makes it stale.

variant.description: Matrix variant key when this record lives at markets/<market-id>/<variant-key>/decisions/native_review.json and covers that variant's inventory and translation sheet; absent or null for the market's own record.

decided_by.description: Who gave the sign-off. Never the agent, in either approval mode.

evidence.description: The reviewer's or user's own words, quoted.

reviewed.description: Every reviewed file, relative to the folder that holds decisions/ (the market folder, or the variant folder). translation.md and inventory.md are required.

card_fields_sha256.description: market_card.py fingerprint review_fields_sha256: the canonical hash of the card's languages, casting_notes, settings_notes, props_wardrobe_notes, gestures_and_taboos, legal_lines and currency at sign-off.
